dogecoin.text:
The prices of many prominent cryptocurrencies were already at record highs before the public listing.

Bitcoin rose past its record high to hit a value of $64,829.

Ether also rose to $2,398.

Even dogecoin (which can't even be traded on Coindesk’s platform) rose 40%.

Dogecoin is now worth $40 billion. Thanks to @coinbase's valuation and the record-breaking highs of bitcoin & ether, dogecoin has jumped 400% in a week. There are now dogecoin millionaires. Some are attributing the spike, to @elonmusk’s tweet: “Doge Barking at the Moon.” https://t.co/ny6xBYQa3S
